extName.description: Extension name, shown in chrome://extensions and the Web Store

extDescription.message: A vertical tab bar with page previews in Chrome's side panel.

actionTitle.description: Toolbar button tooltip. Never embed a keyboard shortcut here: the real binding is added at runtime with actionTitleWithShortcut

actionTitleWithShortcut.description: Toolbar button tooltip including the shortcut the user actually has

cmdSearchTabs.message: Open the vertical tab bar and search tabs
cmdSearchTabs.description: Description of the search-tabs keyboard command in chrome://extensions/shortcuts

tabs.description: Accessible name of the tab list

pinnedTabs.description: Accessible name of the pinned-tab grid

searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder and label of the search box

clearSearch.description: Button that empties the search box

otherWindows.description: Heading over search matches that live in a different window

searchNoResults.description: Shown when the filter hides every tab

searchCountOne.description: Match counter shown while filtering a window that holds exactly one tab (M is 1). chrome.i18n has no plural rules, so the singular is a separate message; locales without plural inflection repeat the plural string here.

unreadTab.description: Screen-reader text on a tab that was opened in the background and not seen yet

popOut.description: Aria label for the pop-out button

popOutTooltip.message: Open this tab list in its own window, which can be narrower than Chrome's side panel

lockTab.description: Context-menu item that protects a tab from the panel's own close actions

unlockTab.description: Context-menu item that removes the lock

lockedTabTooltip.message: Locked. Nothing in this panel will close it; Chrome's own close button still will.
lockedTabTooltip.description: Tooltip on the lock badge, stating exactly how far the lock reaches

lockedTabKept.description: Toast when a close request included one locked tab

lockedTabsKept.description: Toast when a close request included several

closeTab.description: Close button on a card, and menu item

closeNTabs.description: Menu item when several selected tabs would be closed

hibernateTab.description: Context-menu item that discards the tab to free memory

hibernated.description: Tooltip suffix on a discarded tab

cmdPalette.description: Accessible name of the command palette

cmdMoveToNewWindow.message: Move this tab to a new window

cmdPopOut.message: Open the list in its own window

refreshPreview.description: Context-menu item that recaptures the preview of the active tab

closedWindow.description: Trash entry for a closed window

closedWindowOne.description: Trash entry for a closed window that held exactly one tab. chrome.i18n has no plural rules, so the singular is a separate message; locales without plural inflection repeat the plural string here.

restoreTab.description: Accessible name of a row in the closed-tabs list

operationFailed.message: Chrome could not complete that action. Try again.
operationFailed.description: Toast after a failed tab operation

groupMoveInvalid.message: A group cannot be dropped inside another group or among pinned tabs.
groupMoveInvalid.description: Toast when Chrome rejects a group move

groupUntitled.description: Label for a group with no title

groupTabCount.description: Tab counter on a group header

groupTabCountOne.description: Tab counter on a group header holding exactly one tab. chrome.i18n has no plural rules, so the singular is a separate message; locales without plural inflection repeat the plural string here.

audioPlaying.description: Audio button on a card that is making sound

audioMuted.description: Audio button on a muted card

loading.description: Card state while the page is loading

previewPending.message: The preview appears after this tab has been shown

previewCapturing.description: Tooltip while a capture is in flight

previewUnavailable.message: No preview is available for this page
previewUnavailable.description: Tooltip on pages Chrome refuses to screenshot, such as chrome:// pages

previewExcluded.message: Previews are turned off for this site
previewExcluded.description: Tooltip on a site the user added to the exclusion list

previewIncognito.message: Previews are never made in a private window
previewIncognito.description: Tooltip on the preview box of a tab in a private window

previewNoSiteAccess.message: Chrome is not letting this extension read this site, so no preview can be made
previewNoSiteAccess.description: Tooltip when site access is withheld

previewUnavailableShort.description: Short label drawn inside the preview box of a page Chrome refuses to screenshot

previewExcludedShort.description: Short label drawn inside the preview box of a site the user excluded

previewIncognitoShort.description: Short label on the preview box of a tab in a private window

previewNoSiteAccessShort.description: Short label drawn inside the preview box when Chrome withholds site access

previewDisabledByPolicyShort.description: Short label drawn inside the preview box when a policy disables screenshots

previewDisabledByPolicy.description: Tooltip when an administrator policy blocks screenshots

previewStale.description: Tooltip on an out-of-date preview kept while the new page loads

bannerScreenshotsDisabled.message: Screenshots are disabled by policy on this computer, so previews are paused.
bannerScreenshotsDisabled.description: Banner shown while a policy blocks screenshots

bannerSiteAccess.message: Previews are unavailable because Chrome is withholding website access from this extension. Set its site access to "On all sites".
bannerSiteAccess.description: Banner shown when the user or an administrator withheld site access

bannerSiteAccessOpen.description: Button that opens this extension's details page

confirmClose.description: Confirm button of the bulk-close confirmation

confirmClearCache.description: Confirmation before clearing the preview cache

confirmDelete.description: Confirm button of a destructive confirmation

cacheCleared.description: Toast after the preview cache was cleared

settingsColumns.description: Settings control: how many columns of tab cards the panel shows

settingsColumnsHelp.message: When the panel is too narrow for the number you pick, it shows as many columns as fit.
settingsColumnsHelp.description: Help text under the column-count control

settingsCardWidth.description: Settings label for the card width cap

settingsCardWidthHelp.message: Chrome fixes the panel's own width at 360 px minimum and an extension cannot change it. Choosing a card size fills the panel with as many cards of that size as fit, instead of one wide column.
settingsCardWidthHelp.description: Help text under the card width select

widgets.description: Aria label for the widget rail

settingsWidgets.description: Settings section heading for the widget rail

settingsWidgetsHelp.message: Chrome will not let the panel be narrower than 360 px, so the space beside the tabs holds these instead. None of them uses the network. Untick them all to hide the column.
settingsWidgetsHelp.description: Help text under the widget list

widgetListIOCopy.description: Button copying the window's tabs as a Markdown list

widgetListIOOpen.description: Button opening every link found in the box

widgetListIONothing.description: Toast when no tab has an http(s) URL

widgetListIOOpened.message: Opened $COUNT$ links in a new window.

widgetNowPlaying.description: Widget name: tabs currently making sound

widgetNowPlayingEmpty.description: Shown when no tab is making sound

settingsPinnedGrid.message: Show pinned tabs as a compact grid

settingsDoubleClickNewTab.message: Double-click empty space to open a new tab

settingsUnreadDot.message: Mark tabs opened in the background as unread

settingsClickActiveSwitchesBack.message: Clicking the active tab switches to the previous tab

settingsConfirmThreshold.message: Ask before closing this many tabs at once

settingsPreviewMoment.description: Settings control choosing what moment of a page a preview shows

settingsPreviewMomentHelp.message: A preview is a picture of the visible part of a page. Chrome puts you back where you were when a page reloads, so a preview taken then can be a band of body text that identifies nothing.
settingsPreviewMomentHelp.description: Help text under the preview-moment control

previewMomentReload.message: What it showed when it loaded

previewMomentInterval.message: Wherever you are on the page

settingsRefresh.description: Settings control for the periodic refresh

settingsCaptureBeforeSwitch.message: Update the preview of the tab you are leaving

settingsCaptureWhenClosed.message: Capture previews while the tab bar is closed

settingsExcludedHosts.message: Never capture previews on these sites

settingsExcludedHostsHelp.message: One host per line. Use *.example.com to include subdomains.
settingsExcludedHostsHelp.description: Help text under the excluded-hosts textarea

settingsCacheStatsOne.description: Size of the preview cache when it holds exactly one preview. chrome.i18n has no plural rules, so the singular is a separate message; locales without plural inflection repeat the plural string here. English takes the plural at zero, so only 1 needs this form.

settingsClearCache.description: Button that deletes every stored preview

shortcutToggle.message: Show or hide the tab bar

shortcutUnassigned.description: Shown when a command has no shortcut

version.description: Extension version in the About section

sidePositionHint.message: Chrome is showing this panel on the left. To move it to the right, change the side panel position in Chrome settings › Appearance.
sidePositionHint.description: One-time hint shown when Chrome docks the side panel on the left

openUrlManually.description: Toast when Chrome refuses to open an internal page for us

timeJustNow.description: Relative time in the closed-tabs list

timeMinutesAgo.description: Relative time in the closed-tabs list

timeHoursAgo.description: Relative time in the closed-tabs list

timeDaysAgo.description: Relative time in the closed-tabs list

welcomeOpen.message: Click the extension icon in the toolbar or press $SHORTCUT$ to open the tab bar.
welcomeOpen.description: Welcome page: how to open the panel

welcomeOpenNow.description: Welcome page button that opens the side panel straight away

welcomePin.message: Tip: pin the icon from the puzzle-piece menu so it is always visible.

welcomeSide.message: Chrome decides which side the panel appears on. To use the right side, change the side panel position under Settings › Appearance.
welcomeSide.description: Welcome page: the side of the panel is a Chrome setting

welcomeChromeVerticalTabs.message: If Chrome's own vertical tab strip is turned on, turn it off so you do not end up with two tab lists.
welcomeChromeVerticalTabs.description: Welcome page: avoid two competing vertical tab lists

welcomePermissions.message: Previews need the "Read and change all your data on all websites" permission because Chrome only allows screenshots of the active tab with it. Previews stay on this computer and are never uploaded.

welcomeSettings.message: Settings live inside the tab bar (gear icon).
welcomeSettings.description: Welcome page: where the settings are

widgetSessionsNothing.message: No page in this window can be saved

widgetRecentNone.message: No other tab has been visited yet.

widgetRecentUnsupported.message: This Chrome does not record when a tab was last used.

widgetWindowsAlone.description: Shown when one window is open

widgetWindowsUntitled.description: Fallback name for a window with no readable tab

widgetWindowsHere.description: Tab count for the window this panel drives

widgetAutoGroupRun.description: Button that creates one tab group per site

widgetAutoGroupUndo.description: Button that ungroups what the last run grouped

widgetAutoGroupNone.message: No site has two loose tabs.
widgetAutoGroupNone.description: Shown when there is nothing to group

widgetAutoGroupFound.description: How much the tool would group

widgetStaleUnsupported.message: This Chrome does not report when a tab was last used

widgetScratchpadPlaceholder.message: Anything you would otherwise keep a tab open for
